description: The Go / No-Go's "fields" row for a departure, destination or stop that NASR lists as closed (APT_BASE ARPT_STATUS not O: "00MO is closed indefinitely (NASR): it cannot be planned as a landing field", decision 0043), private (FACILITY_USE_CODE PR: "IL11 is private: land only with the owner's permission (call 847-323-8911)") or military-only ("prior permission required (PPR)"), the phone NASR APT_CON's; 14 CFR 91.103 (all available information). A caution, opening the Depart tab for the departure and Arrive otherwise; null where every field is open and public or joint use. The hosts add it to gonogo_verdict_items' list before gonogo_verdict_line.

private.description: NASR FACILITY_USE_CODE PR, not owned by the armed services.

military.description: "military" or "joint" for a field the armed services own (OWNERSHIP_TYPE_CODE MA, MN, MR, CG).

phone.description: NASR APT_CON's phone, the manager's or else the owner's.

status.description: NASR APT_BASE's ARPT_STATUS (O, CI, CP); null where the host has no NASR record.
